notes: spin.co.in does not serve live storefront content (per prior Home Decor pass, and re-confirmed: only madewithspin.com is live). Reached madewithspin.com entirely via the Claude-in-Chrome connector in one dedicated tab. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (only /admin, /cgi-bin blocked) and lists a sitemap. Tree sources used per the mandatory union rule: (1) sitemap_collections_1.xml (236 collection handles, enumerated fully), (2) the site's mobile-navigation drawer (top departments: New, Living, Dining, Home Bars, Home Office, Accessories, Outdoor, Bedroom, Kids, Design Desk, Collaboration), (3) each candidate collection page's own left-hand filter/breadcrumb tree (Shopify theme renders 'Department > Group > Node' chips on every collection page), which was the most reliable source and was used to positively confirm real parent/child relationships and rule out marketing/filter duplicates. SPIN is a room-organized (not product-type-organized) Indian furniture brand: Living, Dining, Home Bars, Home Office, Outdoor, Bedroom and Kids departments each contain real furniture sub-categories; Accessories/Vases/Planters/Trays/Candle Holders/Mirrors/Tableware/Textiles/Lighting were excluded as decor/lighting/kitchen per the brief. 'Design Desk' (a B2B design-services page, not a product listing) and 'Collaboration' (designer collab landing linking to Strange Co and Fujihoro tableware lines) were inspected and excluded as non-catalog pages. qty method: Rule 3 full enumeration - same-origin fetch() of /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250, paginated to an empty page, deduped by numeric product id, run from the loaded page's own JS context via javascript_tool. This was cross-checked against the rendered 'N products' header on 10 of the 28 leaf pages (sofa-lounger 30=30, center-table 36=36, consoles 16=16, dining-tables 11=11, outdoor-seating 30=30, beds 11=11, home-bar 16=16, study-tables 9=9, study-chairs 32=32, sofa-loungers-for-office 36=36) - all matched exactly with no inflation, so products.json enumeration was trusted for the remaining leaves without a header re-check (two independent confirmations already established the method is exact on this store; a third check would be redundant per the efficiency rule). Excluded as non-furniture after opening and title-scanning: office-storage, study-storage, study-accessories, kids-storage, bar-storage, bar-accessories, bins (all turned out to be desktop organisers/trays/pen-holders/storage boxes/wastebins, not furniture, despite storage-sounding handles - verified by product-title inspection per the brief's 'node identity from slug is unreliable' trap). Excluded as marketing/rollup/duplicate pages (parent-with-extractable-children or attribute filters, per URL hierarchy and no-marketing-collections rules): 'dining' (191, whole department incl. tableware), 'dining-furniture' (70, all-dining-furniture rollup of tables+chairs+benches already captured individually), 'bedroom-furniture' (57, whole-bedroom rollup of beds+bedside-table+sofas-loungers+study-table already captured individually - kept as an is_group row instead), 'bar', 'bar-1', 'bar-furniture', 'mini-bar', 'walnut-home-bars', 'infinity-home-bars', 'eco-bars', 'bar-console' (all subsets/aliases of home-bar with heavily overlapping product sets, not independently confirmed nav destinations), outdoor-chairs/outdoor-benches-stools/balcony-chairs/bistro-* (attribute-style subsets of outdoor-seating, not confirmed as the site's own outdoor-seating page listed only Outdoor Seating/Outdoor Tables/Outdoor Trolley/Bistro Collection(marketing)/Planters(decor) as its real siblings), armchairs/highback-sofas/sectional/single-seater-lounger/stools/book-shelves/tv-consoles/consoles-media-units/corner-range/table-set/accent-table/accent-side-table/tables-with-wheels/entryway/workstations/mydesk/study-table(singular)/storage/storage-1/storage-2/euro-storage/small-storage* (all style/material/room-crossover filter pages with product sets overlapping the confirmed primary collections; entryway specifically mixes 1 furniture item with mostly coat-hooks/umbrella-holders and was dropped as non-furniture-dominant). 'Home bars' is cross-linked from both the Living filter panel and its own Home Bars department to the identical /collections/home-bar URL; recorded once, under Home Bars. Sanity checks per §4: none of the confirmed counts were suspiciously round or constant across categories; h1/page titles matched the intended node on every page opened (e.g. study-chairs page title literally 'Home Office Chair', sofa-loungers-for-office literally 'Sofas/Loungers for Office'); no sponsored/PLA tiles observed in products.json. All confirmed qty are current live counts (Rule 1 method never used a padded/inflated source).
